info.title: Polymarket API
info.description: RESTful API for querying Polymarket prediction markets data including events, markets, traders, holders, and real-time metrics

get.description: Returns historical price data for supported crypto assets from Polymarket API

parameters.name: asset_symbol
parameters.description: Asset ticker: BTC, ETH, XRP, SOL, DOGE, BNB, HYPE

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start timestamp in seconds (Unix epoch, inclusive)

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End timestamp in seconds (Unix epoch, inclusive)

parameters.name: pagination_key
parameters.description: Cursor from previous response for keyset pagination. Pass the pagination_key from the previous page to fetch the next page.

200.description: Successful response

400.description: Bad request - missing or invalid parameters

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of events with filtering, sorting, and optional nested tags/markets

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Filter by event ID(s) - comma-separated (max 50). Cannot be used with 'event_slugs'. Example: id=99600,99601,99583

parameters.name: event_slugs
parameters.description: Filter by event slug(s) - comma-separated (max 50). Cannot be used with 'id'. Example: event_slugs=will-trump-win,bitcoin-100k

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search in title and description (3-100 characters). Example: search=trump

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Sort: volume, txns, unique_traders, title, creation_date, start_date, end_date, relevance (relevance only works in search mode) (default: volume)

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status: open, closed, or all (default: all)

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Filter by tag slug(s) - comma-separated (max 50). Example: tags=sports,football,crypto

parameters.name: min_unique_traders
parameters.description: Minimum unique traders in selected timeframe

parameters.name: max_unique_traders
parameters.description: Maximum unique traders in selected timeframe

parameters.name: include_markets
parameters.description: Include markets array with outcomes (default: true)

parameters.name: include_metrics
parameters.description: Include metrics object with all timeframes (default: true)

parameters.name: ai
parameters.description: Return truncated response optimized for AI consumers (default: false)

200.description: List of Polymarket events with nested tags, markets, and series. Response includes `pagination: { has_more, pagination_key }` for cursor-based pagination.

400.description: Bad request - validation error (search length, array limits, conflicting params)

get.description: Retrieve price data over time for up to 4 markets with highest YES outcome (outcome_index 0) prices in an event. Perfect for rendering multi-line charts showing price movement across top markets. TradingView-style: resolution parameter determines both candle size and implicit lookback period.

parameters.name: condition_ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated condition IDs to include (max 4, optional)

parameters.name: market_slugs
parameters.description: Comma-separated market slugs to include (max 4, optional). Use either condition_ids or market_slugs, not both

parameters.name: resolution
parameters.description: Time interval with implicit lookback: 1H (1 hour), 6H (6 hours), 1D (1 day), 1W (1 week), 1M (30 days), ALL (all data) (required)

200.description: Price data over time for up to 4 markets with highest YES odds

get.description: Retrieve volume, transaction, and trader metrics for an event. Supports single timeframe (e.g., '1m'), multiple timeframes (e.g., '1m,5m,1h'), or 'all' to get all available timeframes.

200.description: Event metrics. **Note:** returns a single object for one timeframe, or an array of objects for comma-separated timeframes or 'all'.

get.description: Returns the winning outcome name for each resolved market in an event, keyed by market slug. Useful for quickly checking which outcomes won across a series.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of resolved markets per page (default: 10, max: 250)

parameters.name: pagination_key
parameters.description: Cursor-based pagination key for fetching next page

200.description: Map of market_slug → winning outcome name with pagination metadata

get.description: Retrieve a single event by its slug with optional nested tags, markets, and metrics

parameters.name: include_markets
parameters.description: Include markets array with outcomes (default: true)

parameters.name: include_metrics
parameters.description: Include metrics object with all timeframes (default: true)

parameters.name: ai
parameters.description: Return truncated response optimized for AI consumers (default: false)

200.description: Event with nested tags, markets, and series

get.summary: Get event by ID or slug
get.description: Retrieve a single event by its numeric ID or slug with optional nested tags, markets, and metrics

parameters.name: include_markets
parameters.description: Include markets array with outcomes (default: true)

parameters.name: include_metrics
parameters.description: Include metrics object with all timeframes (default: true)

parameters.name: ai
parameters.description: Return truncated response optimized for AI consumers (default: false)

200.description: Event with nested tags, markets, and series

get.description: Retrieve holders of a market grouped by outcome, sorted by shares held. Identify the market with either `condition_id` or `market_slug` — exactly one must be provided. Set `include_pnl=true` to include a nested holder `pnl` object.

parameters.name: include_pnl
parameters.description: Include nested holder PnL data (default: false, +1 credit)

parameters.name: ai
parameters.description: Return truncated response optimized for AI consumers (default: false)

200.description: Market holders grouped by outcome (sorted by shares DESC). Holder `pnl` is included only when `include_pnl=true`.

get.description: Retrieve historical holder count snapshots for a market over a time range. Identify the market with either `condition_id` or `market_slug` — exactly one must be provided.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start timestamp (Unix seconds). If omitted, derived from `hours` param.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End timestamp (Unix seconds). Defaults to now.

parameters.name: count_back
parameters.description: Number of candles to return (default: 500, max: 2500)

parameters.name: hours
parameters.description: Fallback time range in hours when `from`/`to` are not provided (default: 24, max: 336 = 14 days)

parameters.name: pagination_key
parameters.description: Cursor-based pagination key from previous response

200.description: Market holder count history with automatic granularity (1m/5m/15m/1h/6h buckets)

get.description: Retrieve holders of a specific position (ERC1155 token), sorted by shares held. Set `include_pnl=true` to include nested holder PnL. Uses cursor-based pagination for efficient traversal.

parameters.name: include_pnl
parameters.description: Include nested holder PnL data (default: false, +1 credit)

parameters.name: ai
parameters.description: Return truncated response optimized for AI consumers (default: false)

200.description: Position holders (sorted by shares DESC). Holder `pnl` is included only when `include_pnl=true`. Response includes `pagination: { has_more, pagination_key }` for cursor-based pagination.

get.description: Retrieve historical holder count snapshots for a position over a time range

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start timestamp (Unix seconds). If omitted, derived from `hours` param.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End timestamp (Unix seconds). Defaults to now.

parameters.name: count_back
parameters.description: Number of candles to return (default: 500, max: 2500)

parameters.name: hours
parameters.description: Fallback time range in hours when `from`/`to` are not provided (default: 24, max: 336 = 14 days)

parameters.name: pagination_key
parameters.description: Cursor-based pagination key from previous response

200.description: Position holder count history with automatic granularity (1m/5m/15m/1h/6h buckets)

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of markets with filtering, sorting, and optional nested tags/events/metrics

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status: open, closed, or all (default: all)

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Sort: volume, txns, unique_traders, liquidity, holders, total_daily_rate, end_time, start_time, created_time, relevance

parameters.name: min_unique_traders
parameters.description: Minimum unique traders in selected timeframe

parameters.name: max_unique_traders
parameters.description: Maximum unique traders in selected timeframe

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Filter markets with end_time >= start_time (Unix timestamp)

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: Filter markets with end_time <= end_time (Unix timestamp)

parameters.name: has_rewards

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Sort by: apy, liquidity, volume, end_date (default: end_date)

200.description: List of bond markets

parameters.name: pagination_key
parameters.description: Cursor-based pagination key from previous response

200.description: OHLCV candlestick data

get.description: Retrieve price data over time for up to 4 position outcomes in a market condition. TradingView-style: resolution parameter determines both candle size and implicit lookback period. Auto-selects the 4 most active outcomes if position_ids not specified.

parameters.name: condition_id
parameters.description: Market condition ID or market_slug (one required)

parameters.name: position_ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of position IDs (max 4, optional). Auto-selected if not provided

parameters.name: resolution
parameters.description: Time interval with implicit lookback: 1H (1 hour), 6H (6 hours), 1D (1 day), 1W (1 week), 1M (30 days), ALL (all data) (required)

200.description: Price data over time for up to 4 market outcomes

get.description: Retrieve volume, transaction, and trader metrics for a market. Supports single timeframe (e.g., '1m'), multiple timeframes (e.g., '1m,5m,1h'), or 'all' to get all available timeframes.

200.description: Market metrics. **Note:** returns a single object for one timeframe, or an array of objects for comma-separated timeframes or 'all'.

get.description: Retrieve OHLCV candlestick data for a specific position by its position_id

parameters.name: pagination_key
parameters.description: Cursor-based pagination key from previous response

200.description: OHLCV candlestick data

get.description: Retrieve volume, transaction, and trader metrics for a specific position. Supports single timeframe (e.g., '1m'), multiple timeframes (e.g., '1m,5m,1h'), or 'all' to get all available timeframes.

200.description: Position metrics. **Note:** returns a single object for one timeframe, or an array of objects for comma-separated timeframes or 'all'.

get.description: Retrieve volume over time for a specific position with buy/sell breakdown

parameters.name: pagination_key
parameters.description: Cursor-based pagination key from previous response

200.description: Volume with buy/sell breakdown over time

get.description: Scan candles for significant price movements. Returns jumps with from/to timestamps in milliseconds, directly usable as trades API time range parameters to identify traders who traded before or during the movement.

parameters.name: condition_id
parameters.description: Market condition ID (one of condition_id or market_slug required)

parameters.name: min_change_pct
parameters.description: Minimum relative percent change to qualify as a jump (default: 10.0)

parameters.name: lookback
parameters.description: Number of candles to scan back from now (default: 1440, max: 2500)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Offset in candles from now — window is [now - (lookback + offset) * resolution, now - offset * resolution] (default: 0)

200.description: Price jumps sorted by timestamp descending

get.description: Retrieve one or more markets by slug. Supports batch lookups via query params. Returns an array of MarketResponse objects.

parameters.name: position_ids

parameters.name: ai

parameters.name: all
parameters.description: Return all-time trades, not just last 30 days (default: false)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Pagination offset (number of results to skip). Takes precedence over pagination_key.

parameters.name: pagination_key
parameters.description: Cursor-based pagination key obtained from previous response's pagination.pagination_key

parameters.name: ai
parameters.description: Return truncated response optimized for AI consumers (default: false)

parameters.name: pagination_key
parameters.description: Cursor-based pagination key from previous response

200.description: Volume breakdown by YES/NO over time

get.description: Retrieve one or more markets by condition ID. Supports batch lookups via query params. Returns an array of MarketResponse objects.

parameters.name: position_ids

parameters.name: ai

get.description: Returns the latest CLOB orderbook snapshot for a position, including derived metrics (best bid/ask, mid price, spread, liquidity depth). Data is sourced from the real-time Polymarket WebSocket feed. `bids` and `asks` are arrays of `{"p": price, "s": size}` objects, sorted best-first.

200.description: Latest orderbook snapshot. ts is Unix milliseconds.

get.description: Paginated history of raw CLOB orderbook snapshots including full bids/asks levels and derived metrics. Default limit 20, max 200. `bids` and `asks` are arrays of `{"p": price, "s": size}` objects, sorted best-first.

parameters.name: position_id
parameters.description: Token ID (required if condition_id / market_slug not set)

parameters.name: condition_id
parameters.description: Condition ID — returns history for all positions in this market

parameters.name: min_spread
parameters.description: Only return snapshots with spread >= this value

parameters.name: max_spread
parameters.description: Only return snapshots with spread <= this value

parameters.name: min_liquidity
parameters.description: Only return snapshots where total liquidity (bid + ask) >= this value

200.description: Orderbook snapshot rows, newest first. ts is Unix milliseconds.

get.summary: Get order books for a market
get.description: Returns the latest orderbook snapshot for every position (outcome) in a market. Accepts condition_id or market_slug. `bids` and `asks` are arrays of `{"p": price, "s": size}` objects, sorted best-first.

200.description: Latest orderbook snapshot per position. ts is Unix milliseconds.

get.description: Lightweight time series of derived orderbook metrics (best bid/ask, mid price, spread, liquidity depth) without raw bids/asks — ideal for charting. Default limit 20, max 200.

parameters.name: position_id
parameters.description: Token ID (required if condition_id / market_slug not set)

parameters.name: condition_id
parameters.description: Condition ID — returns spread history for all positions in this market

parameters.name: min_spread
parameters.description: Only return rows with spread >= this value

parameters.name: max_spread
parameters.description: Only return rows with spread <= this value

parameters.name: min_liquidity
parameters.description: Only return rows where total liquidity (bid + ask) >= this value

200.description: Spread time series rows, newest first. ts is Unix milliseconds.

items.description: Lightweight row — derived metrics only, no bids/asks JSONB.

get.description: Search across markets, events, and traders. Use `type` to limit which categories are searched. Trader search supports wallet address lookup or name search. Results for each category are independently paginated. Only requested categories are included in the response.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search query (min 2 characters). Prefix with 0x for exact wallet address lookup.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Comma-separated categories to search: events, markets, traders (default: all three, 1 credit per type). Example: type=markets,traders

parameters.name: include_pnl
parameters.description: Include lifetime PnL summary for each trader (default: false, +1 credit)

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Sort field applied to both events and markets (default: volume). Fields marked events-only or markets-only fall back to volume on the other category.

parameters.name: timeframe
parameters.description: Metrics timeframe used for volume/txns/unique_traders sort (default: 24h)

parameters.name: events_pagination_key
parameters.description: Cursor for the next page of events, obtained from previous response's events_pagination.pagination_key

parameters.name: markets_pagination_key
parameters.description: Cursor for the next page of markets, obtained from previous response's markets_pagination.pagination_key

parameters.name: traders_pagination_key
parameters.description: Cursor for the next page of traders, obtained from previous response's traders_pagination.pagination_key

200.description: Search results. Only requested categories (via `type`) are included in the response.

400.description: Bad request — q is missing or shorter than 2 characters

get.description: Retrieve series. Use `id` or `series_slug` for single lookup, `series_ids` or `series_slugs` (comma-separated, max 250, mutually exclusive) for multi-lookup, or paginate with `active_only`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Single series ID for direct lookup

parameters.name: series_ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated series IDs (max 250). Mutually exclusive with series_slugs.

parameters.name: series_slugs
parameters.description: Comma-separated series slugs (max 250). Mutually exclusive with series_ids.

parameters.name: active_only
parameters.description: Only active series (default: true). Ignored when series_ids or series_slugs are provided.

parameters.name: pagination_key
parameters.description: Cursor for pagination: id of the last series from the previous page

200.description: Series or list of series

400.description: series_ids and series_slugs cannot both be provided

get.description: Returns the winning outcome name for each resolved market across all events in a series, keyed by market slug. Useful for checking historical results across recurring series (e.g., btc-updown-5m).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of resolved markets per page (default: 10, max: 250)

parameters.name: pagination_key
parameters.description: Cursor-based pagination key for fetching next page

200.description: Map of market_slug → winning outcome name with pagination metadata

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of events to return (default: 20, max: 250)

get.description: Retrieve all available event tags/categories. Supports both cursor-based and offset-based pagination.

parameters.name: offset

200.description: List of all tags

get.description: Retrieve a single tag by its ID or slug

get.description: Retrieve the global PnL leaderboard ranked by profit and loss. Uses cursor-based pagination for efficient traversal of large datasets.

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Sort: realized_pnl_usd, buys, sells, redemptions, merges, avg_hold_time, markets_traded, events_traded, markets_won, volume_usd, fees, best_trade (default: realized_pnl_usd)

200.description: Global PnL leaderboard with trader stats. Response includes `pagination: { has_more, pagination_key }` for cursor-based pagination.

get.description: Global trader leaderboard ranked by PnL or volume over the selected timeframe. Each entry carries the trader's identity, ranking score (`pnl`), and the full set of Struct trading metrics (volumes split by side, markets_won / markets_lost, win rate, average PnL per market and per trade, average hold time, best trade, fees, and first / last trade timestamps). Enrichment fields are `null` when we don't yet have a row for that address in the selected timeframe.

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Order by: pnl or volume (default: pnl). Case-insensitive.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Market category filter. Case-insensitive. Default: overall.

200.description: Leaderboard rows with full trader metrics.

400.description: Bad request — invalid timeframe, sort_by, or category

get.description: Retrieve a trader's overall profit and loss summary

ApprovalTrade.description: Output payload for ERC1155 setApprovalForAll events.

AssertionDisputedEvent.description: V3 UMA OOv3: an assertion was disputed.

AssertionMadeEvent.description: V3 UMA OOv3: a new assertion (resolution proposal) was made.

AssertionSettledEvent.description: V3 UMA OOv3: an assertion liveness period expired and was settled.

AssetPriceHistoryRow.description: A single asset price history record from the `asset_price_history` table.

asset_open_price.description: Opening price at start_time (cast to f64 from NUMERIC in query)

asset_close_price.description: Closing price at end_time (cast to f64 from NUMERIC in query)

outcome.description: Generated column: "up" if close > open, "down" if close ≤ open, null if no close yet

ConditionMetricsResponse.description: Response type for condition metrics query

ConditionResolutionEvent.description: CTF ConditionResolution: positions become redeemable on the Conditional Tokens contract.

EventMarket.description: Enriched market data for event API responses

EventMarketOutcome.description: Market outcome for event API responses

EventMetricsResponse.description: Response type for event metrics query

GlobalPnlTrader.description: Individual trader entry in the global PnL leaderboard

shares.description: Position shares held (raw balance as string for precision)

shares_usd.description: USD value of shares (shares * latest price)

usd_balance.description: USD balance of wallet (USDe on Polygon)

HolderHistoryCandle.description: Holder statistics data point (single time bucket)

LeaderboardCategory.description:
Market category filter for the trader leaderboard.
Mirrors `common::gamma::categories::Category` plus `overall` (= all).

LeaderboardEntry.description:
Flat response row. `trader` is the canonical `TraderInfo` used across all
our other endpoints; all enrichment fields sit at the top level. Fields
other than `trader`, `rank`, `pnl`, and `timeframe` are sourced from our
`prediction_trader_pnl_*_v2` tables and are `null` when we don't yet have
a row for that address in the selected timeframe.

LeaderboardSortBy.description: Sort key for the trader leaderboard (`GET /polymarket/trader/leaderboard`).

total_holders.description: Total unique holders across all outcomes (from holder_stats)

MarketMetadataOutcome.description: Market outcome with timeframe metrics (websocket API format)

latest_block.description: Block of the most recent price update for this outcome.

latest_confirmed_at.description: Unix-seconds timestamp of the most recent price update.

MarketResponse.description: Formatted market response with structured metrics, tags, outcomes, and event

MergeTrade.description: Output payload for Merge trades (burn outcome tokens → receive collateral).

NegRiskOutcomeReportedEvent.description: NegRisk Adapter: outcome reported for a neg-risk market question.

OrderFilledTrade.description: Output payload for OrderFilled and OrdersMatched trades (actual buy/sell).

OrderbookLevel.description: A single price level in a bids/asks array.

OutcomeHolders.description: Holder data grouped by outcome for market-level queries

PaginationMeta.description: Pagination metadata to include in API responses

has_more.description: Whether there are more results available

pagination_key.description: Pagination key for the next page (if has_more is true)

t.description: Timestamp in epoch seconds (start of bucket window)

PolymarketEvent.description: A Polymarket event from the Gamma API

PolymarketSeries.description:
A Polymarket series from the Gamma API
Series are parent groupings above events (e.g., "NBA Season 2024-25")

PolymarketTag.description: A Polymarket tag from the Gamma API

outcome_index.description: Outcome index (0 = Yes, 1 = No for binary)

outcome.description: Outcome name (e.g. "Yes", "No") — enriched from market metadata

amount.description: Amount of shares created/burned/redeemed for this position

condition_id.description: Condition ID this position belongs to

PositionMetricsResponse.description: Response type for position metrics query

PositionStatus.description: Position status filter for open/closed positions.

PositionsConvertedTrade.description:
Output payload for NegRisk PositionsConverted trades
(convert NO-position tokens → YES tokens + collateral).

index_set.description: Bitmask of question indices whose NO tokens are being converted

QuestionEmergencyResolvedEvent.description: UMA CTF Adapter: admin emergency resolution.

QuestionFlaggedEvent.description: UMA CTF Adapter: market flagged for emergency resolution.

QuestionInitializedEvent.description: UMA CTF Adapter: questionID first initialized on-chain.

QuestionPausedEvent.description: UMA CTF Adapter: market paused by admin.

QuestionResetEvent.description: UMA CTF Adapter: dispute succeeded, market returns to active.

QuestionResolvedEvent.description: UMA CTF Adapter: market resolved with definitive outcome.

RedemptionTrade.description: Output payload for Redemption trades (payout after market resolution).

RegisterTokenTrade.description: Output payload for RegisterToken events (YES/NO token pair registered for a condition).

SearchSortBy.description: Combined sort options valid for both events and markets in search

SplitTrade.description: Output payload for Split trades (deposit collateral → receive outcome tokens).

SpreadRow.description: Lightweight row — derived metrics only, no bids/asks JSONB.

TradeEvent.description:
Tagged enum for all trade types — serializes with `"trade_type": "..."` discriminator
and only includes fields relevant to each type.

Trader.description:
Trader profile info embedded in API responses

Corresponds to SQL function: `pm_build_trader(address, name, pseudonym, profile_image, x_username, verified_badge)`

Used in:
- holders endpoints (market/event holders)
- trades endpoints
- leaderboard endpoints

TraderOutcomePnlEntry.description: Outcome-level PnL entry (per outcome token / position_id)

won.description: TRUE = won, FALSE = lost, NULL = open or sold before resolution

redemption_usd.description: Payout on redemption (non-zero only if won)

avg_entry_price.description: VWAP price paid per share across all buys (0–1)

avg_exit_price.description: VWAP price received per share across all sells (0–1)

current_price.description: Last traded price for this outcome (0–1). NULL if market_outcomes has no price yet.

current_value.description:
Estimated current USD value of held shares: (balance / 1e6) * current_price.
Only meaningful for open positions (balance above dust threshold).

realized_pnl_pct.description:
Realized PnL as a percentage of total spend: (realized_pnl_usd / total_buy_usd) * 100.
NULL when total_buy_usd = 0.

WebhookAssetSymbol.description: Crypto asset symbols accepted by `asset_price_tick` and `asset_price_window_update` filters.

WebhookTimeframe.description: Timeframe values accepted by webhook metric, milestone, spike, and asset-price filters.
